notes: Named on the front page only by its full chemical name, in the (54) title. The trivial name Tembotrione is not printed anywhere in this section, so it is not carried as an alias here; resolution rests on the chemical name, which is unambiguous. role is other because the front page describes an article of manufacture, a crystal modification, and no step prepares the molecule. is_section_product is false because this section is bibliographic metadata and is headed by the issuing office line, not by a compound. Inventor and applicant names, the IPC symbols C07C 317/24 and A01N 41/10, the contracting and extension state codes and the application and publication numbers are not compounds and are not extracted.

The subject of the (54) title, printed as Thermodynamisch stabile Kristallmodifikation without a numeral. It is identified as modification I from [0009] and [0010] of this same document, where thermodynamisch stabile Kristallmodifikation I and Kristallmodifikation I are fixed as the same thing. Same molecule as tembotrione, C17H16ClF3O6S: identical atoms and bonds, differing only in the crystal lattice. It is crystal modification I and is not a distinct chemical entity. role is product because it is the article the application claims; is_section_product is false because the section is bibliographic metadata. Aliases here carry only the spellings this section itself prints. The other spellings this document uses for it sit on the records of the sections that print them, and finalise.py unions them.
